title: From dairy settlement to city
text: Ridgecrest grew to more than 5,000 people by the 1950s, after the Naval Ordnance Test Station was set up at Harvey Field in 1943. It incorporated as a city in 1963. The 2020 census counted 27,959 people.

s2.title: Ridgecrest history (Ridgecrest Guide)
s2.quote: The real game-changer came in 1943 with the establishment of the Naval Ordnance Test Station (NOTS) at Harvey Field. ... By the 1950s, Ridgecrest's population had exploded to over 5,000.

s3.title: Ridgecrest, CA (Digital-Desert)
s3.quote: Ridgecrest, formerly known as Crumville, was incorporated as a city in 1963.
